target.user_context: I am the customer reviewing this agreement for renewal. Flag liability caps, IP ownership, indemnification, termination terms, and any auto-renewal or non-compete clauses.

anatomy.description: Structural parsing of document sections, defined terms, cross-references

planner.description: Thematic clustering of sections with depth assignment

clause_analysis.description: Parallel clause analysis across all clusters
clause_analysis.note: Harness reasoners return stub responses — actual deep analysis requires full opencode harness execution

review_layer.description: Cross-reference resolution, adversary review, gap analysis

synthesis.description: Risk scoring, negotiation strategy, executive summary

report.description: Markdown report and negotiation playbook generation

notes.stub_reasoners: The harness reasoner wrappers in pipeline.py return empty/stub responses. The 0-finding result is expected. For production use, the opencode harness provider would execute multi-turn LLM sessions producing real findings.
notes.pipeline_validated: Full 7-phase pipeline executes end-to-end through AgentField control plane API with proper DAG tracking, VC generation, and async execution.
notes.api_pattern: POST /api/v1/execute/async/contract-af.analyze with {"input": {"document_text": "...", "user_context": "..."}} — exactly how a backend developer would integrate.

comparison_to_sec_af.difference: Contract-AF is faster because harness reasoners return stubs rather than executing multi-turn LLM sessions. With real harness execution, expect 30-90 minutes for a 26K-word contract.
